prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Design a polished Have a Great Day consumer weather planning interface in the visual direction "The Departure Board". Make the primary decision obvious in one second.
Scene/backdrop: one continuous cold off-white ground across the full canvas, no panels floating on a page and no fake browser chrome.
Structure: a slim 64px header with the Have a Great Day wordmark at left and one compact current-place control at right. Below, use a generous editorial two-column composition. On the left, make the recommendation monumental and dominant. Below it, show one human explanation and a quiet row of four real metrics. Across the lower third, add one thin seven-day timetable rail with a restrained split-flap departure-board rhythm. Beneath that rail, show exactly two compact later alternatives. Activity change is one compact inline control near the recommendation, not multiple fields.
Typography: crisp modern grotesk sans serif, editorial scale, exceptionally clear hierarchy, large black recommendation type, tabular numerals for times and metrics, precise small labels. Mostly square corners with at most 8px rounding.
Color palette: background #f3f4ef, text and hairlines #171a18, one forest accent #3f7f58 only.
Materials/textures: powder-coated timetable hardware translated into flat digital UI, quiet split-flap rhythm, precise 1px hairlines, matte surfaces, no shadows.
Text (verbatim): "Have a Great Day"; "San Francisco, CA"; "Tomorrow"; "7:00 to 9:00 AM"; "Best for a walk"; "Cool, dry air and low UV make this the easiest window for a comfortable walk."; "Activity"; "Walk"; "24 C"; "Rain 1%"; "Air 82 AQI"; "UV 1.0"; "Sun"; "Mon"; "Tue"; "Wed"; "Thu"; "Fri"; "Sat"; "Later options"; "Thursday 6:30 to 8:00 AM"; "Friday 7:00 to 8:30 AM".
Constraints: shippable high fidelity product UI, extremely clean alignment and whitespace, minimal, intuitive, relatable consumer tool. Reproduce all supplied text exactly with no extra characters. The recommendation is the visual anchor. Seven-day rail is one continuous horizontal timetable, not seven separate cards.
Avoid: gradients, multicolor status cards, dashboard card grid, huge buttons, giant Privacy button, fake browser chrome, weather icon grid, em dash, en dash, decorative dots, glass effects, excessive pills, rounded card stacks, illustrations, photos, generic SaaS dashboard styling.
